title: Hardware vs. Software
description: Hardware is the stuff you can touch. Software is the instructions that tell it what to do. Kip and Bub explain the difference with a piano and sheet music, and why an update can make an old phone feel new.

scenes.say: Here's a puzzle. Two phones, same model, bought the same day. One of them suddenly gets new features overnight. Nothing about it changed on the outside. So what happened?
Today on Tech from Scratch: hardware versus software.
Every computer is made of two kinds of things. Hardware is the physical stuff, the parts you could actually touch. The screen, the keyboard, the chip inside, the battery.
Software is the instructions. You can't hold it in your hand. It's the apps, the settings, the operating system, everything that tells the hardware what to do.
Think of a piano. The piano is the hardware. The sheet music is the software. Same piano, different music, and you get a completely different song.

One piece of software is extra important: the operating system. On a computer, that's usually Windows or macOS. On a phone, it's iPhone's iOS or Android. It's the conductor. It runs the hardware and lets all your other apps take turns.

card.text: The operating system is the conductor.

scenes.say: So back to our two phones. One of them got a software update. New instructions, same hardware. That's how a phone can get new features without anyone opening it up.
Updates also fix mistakes and close security holes, so it's a good idea to install them.

card.text: Updates fix problems and keep you safer.
card.sub: When your device asks, it’s usually worth saying yes

scenes.say: But software can only do so much. If the hardware is old or slow, at some point new instructions won't fit. That's when it's time for new hardware.

Hardware is the stuff. Software is the instructions. The operating system keeps them working together. Next time, we'll go online and find out what the internet actually is. Subscribe so you don't miss it.

shorts.hook: How your phone gets new features overnight
